lines.en: I inch forward
I am round, I roll along
The grass is much taller than I am
I stop between two stones
My body shines black
I have no feet, I can only scoot
I scoot toward the light
My black fuzz brushes the grass.

lines.zh: 我在地上留下浅浅的痕
lines.en: I leave a faint trail on the ground
I hop, then pause.
I move a little and rest
I squeeze through the grass
I lie on the ground
My eyes are very big
I am watching a leaf
This place is safe

lines.zh: 我还很小，只有一点点血
lines.en: I am small, with only a little health
When I am still, the grass is quiet
I open my mouth
The sun feels warm on me
I am waiting for you to crouch
There are a few others beside me
I roll half a turn
The soil smells good
I turn my round body
I wait for a shadow to pass
You crouched down
My name is Botamon
I am only the size of your palm
You talk very loudly
I am not very good at walking
Will you feed me
I will grow bigger later
Your finger is thicker than I am
Let us sit in the sun together
I have not seen anything like you
Are you picking me up
May I follow you
I am a little frightened

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，也很精神。
lines.en: Two health points and full of spirit.
I will always remember you
Do not step on me
I curl into a small round ball
I am knocked into a roll
I let out a tiny wail
My body aches
I slowly roll back
This is the first time I have been hit
I burrow under the grass roots
I am small, I cannot take much
I shiver and steady myself
I need to rest a while
I smell food
Is that rookie feed
I will roll over and eat
You hold the feed too high.
My mouth is small, I eat slowly
This will last me a long while
I cannot bite into it
Hold still, I cannot reach
This is good, truly
I will want more after this
My mouth is already watering
Do not hold it too far
You stepped on my round body
I was pushed into half a roll

lines.zh: 我一动不动的时候更安全
lines.en: I am safer when I keep still
That flipped me over
I roll my round body over.
Your foot is far bigger than I am
You blocked me in the grass
I am only a little thing
I scoot away from your foot
I will remember that knock forever
I am young, that comes later
There are many of us in the forest
Two little black blobs snuggle up.
A few of us roll about
None of us is much good at walking
Let us soak up the sun together
It is safer to stay close
They are all a little bigger than I
I roll along behind them
This little patch of grass feeds us
You have picked me up
I wobble in your hand
It is so high, I dare not move
I cling to your finger
It would hurt to fall
I press my nose to your palm.
Put me down
I shove it with my body.
I cannot hold it
I rolled it over
Something is coming
I open both round eyes wide.
That thing is much bigger than I am
I try to stand firm

lines.zh: 我第一次面对这么大的东西
lines.en: This is my first time facing something so big
I am trembling a little
I am not much good at fighting
It is looking at me
A soft blob, pressed to the ground.
Should I call out
I am ready to spit a bubble
I must face this one myself
I puff up, ready to bump.

lines.zh: 它每动一下我都缩一下
lines.en: Every time it moves, I flinch
I shift on the ground
I cannot run fast
There is nothing else near me
I slowly puff myself up
It does not look friendly
Let me wait and see
My two big eyes dare not blink
I am ready to charge in low
I keep my escape route in mind
I am keeping my escape route in mind
I spit a bubble
The bubble flew and popped
I roll into it
That really does not hurt
I bump you and bounce softly.
My strength is too small
My round body quivers
It did not even dodge
Let me try once more
I catch my breath
A bubble sticks to your boot.
This time I will try harder
I have come out of the egg
The shell cracked with a crisp sound
I am black and round

lines.zh: 这是我第一次看见森林
lines.en: This is my first sight of the forest
A few others are beside me
The grass is taller than I thought
I lie still first
The sunlight falls on me
I tried how to move
I roll toward the others
I open my eyes in the wood
I roll twice before stopping
Fire is hot, I rolled away

lines.zh: 我被从高处放下来，摔了一下
lines.en: I was set down from a height and hit the ground
Water trapped me

lines.zh: 响声好大，我被震得滚了
lines.en: It was so loud, I was rolled by the shock
Something flying bounced off me
That force pinned me to the ground
Hunger leaves me unable to move
Lightning lit up all the grass
No ground to lie on in the void
